test_write_database_create: test the DataFrame.write_database method to create a new database table from a polars DataFrame
test_write_database_append_replace: test the DataFrame.write_database method with if_table_exists options for append, replace, and fail behaviors
test_write_database_quoted_tablename: test the DataFrame.write_database method with quoted and schema-qualified table names
test_write_database_errors: test the DataFrame.write_database method raises ValueError and TypeError for invalid arguments
test_write_database_adbc_temporary_table: test the DataFrame.write_database method with engine_options to create a temporary table via ADBC
